title: Phase-aware video generation for physics-grounded dynamics and interactions
title_zh: 面向物理基础动力学与相互作用的相感知视频生成

paragraphs.en: Generating physically plausible videos for solid–gas dynamics is challenging as different phases exhibit distinct dynamics yet remain coupled through physical interactions. We present PAVG , a Phase-Aware Video Generator for solid–gas dynamics and interactions. It employs a dual-branch architecture to explicitly model the distinct dynamics of solids and gases, while spatiotemporal cross-attention captures their physical interactions. This design enables PAVG to preserve phase-specific motion characteristics while producing physically consistent responses across phases. To facilitate this task, we further construct a simulation corpus comprising over 700K physical trajectories across diverse solid, gas, and solid–gas interaction scenarios. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our PAVG produces videos with improved motion adherence, physical plausibility, and visual quality compared with existing approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 为固气动力学生成物理上合理的视频具有挑战性，因为不同相表现出不同的动力学特性，但通过物理相互作用仍然相互耦合。 我们提出了 PAVG，一种面向固气动力学及其相互作用的“相感知”视频生成器。 它采用双分支架构来显式建模固体和气体的不同动力学特性，同时利用时空交叉注意力捕捉它们之间的物理相互作用。 这种设计使 PAVG 能够在保持各相特有的运动特征的同时，生成跨相一致且符合物理规律的响应。 为了促进这项任务，我们进一步构建了一个模拟语料库，其中包含超过 70 万个跨越多种固体、气体以及固气相互作用场景的物理轨迹。 广泛的评估表明，与现有方法相比，我们的 PAVG 生成的视频在运动一致性、物理合理性和视觉质量方面均有提升。

paragraphs.en: Many real-world events involve multiple physical phases 1 1 1 In this paper, phase denotes a modeled state of matter, such as solid or gas, rather than a phase transition. and their interactions. As illustrated in Figure 1 , a tennis ball moving right through existing dust can deflect the leftward-drifting plume and induce local curling around the ball. Given an initial image and an external physical intervention, we aim to generate the subsequent video with both high visual fidelity and physically plausible dynamics. This setting requires modeling not only how each phase evolves, but also how motion in one phase influences another, such as when a moving solid induces or alters the motion of surrounding gas.

paragraphs.en: Large-scale video generation models have achieved remarkable visual fidelity and increasingly sophisticated motion generation ( Brooks et al., 2024 ; Blattmann et al., 2023 ; Xing et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Team Wan et al., 2025 ) . However, visual plausibility does not guarantee physical plausibility, and recent evaluations reveal persistent failures in capturing physically plausible motion and interactions ( Bansal et al., 2024 ; Bansal et al., 2025 ) . Such failures become particularly evident in multi-phase scenes: in Figure 1 , the baselines move the ball in the wrong direction, leave the dust stationary, or move both phases together without a visible interaction. Thus, independently plausible phase dynamics are insufficient; the generated motions must also be consistent with their interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 大规模视频生成模型已实现了显著的视觉保真度，并能够生成越来越复杂的运动（Brooks 等，2024；Blattmann 等，2023；Xing 等，2024；Yang 等，2024；Wu 等，2025；Team Wan 等，2025）。 然而，视觉上的合理性并不保证物理上的合理性。近期的评估显示，这些模型在捕捉物理上合理的运动与相互作用方面仍存在持续性的失败（Bansal 等，2024；Bansal 等，2025）。 这类失败在多阶段场景中尤为明显：在图 1 中，基线模型要么将球朝错误的方向移动，要么让尘埃静止不动，要么将两个阶段同时移动却看不到任何相互作用。 因此，各阶段动态的独立合理性并不足够；生成的运动还必须与其相互作用保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Existing physics-grounded video generation approaches address this limitation by incorporating physical dynamics through either explicit simulation or learned physical priors ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025a ; Tan et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Su et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . The simulation-based approaches, however, are computationally expensive and sensitive to numerical settings, such as time step and spatial resolution. They always require repeated solves and parameter adjustment for controllable generation ( Jiang et al., 2016 ; Macklin et al., 2016 ; Modi et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Tan et al., 2024 ) . In contrast, learned physical priors provide a more scalable alternative ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , but multi-phase scenes introduce a fundamental modeling challenge: different phases exhibit distinct dynamics, while their evolution is coupled through physical interactions ( Zhang et al., 2026c ; Tao et al., 2026 ) . Solids may exhibit rigid or deformable motion, whereas gases involve velocity transport, dissipation, pressure, and buoyancy ( Stomakhin et al., 2013 ; Macklin et al., 2016 ; Modi et al., 2024 ; Thuerey & Pfaff, 2018 ; Ummenhofer et al., 2020 ; Winchenbach & Thuerey, 2024 ; Baumgarten et al., 2021 ) . A suitable model therefore needs to preserve phase-specific dynamics while explicitly capturing cross-phase interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的基于物理原理的视频生成方法通过显式模拟或学习物理先验来融入物理动态，从而解决了这一局限性（Xie et al., 2024；Jiang et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2024；Chen et al., 2025a；Tan et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025b；Su et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2024）。 然而，基于模拟的方法计算成本高昂，且对时间步长和空间分辨率等数值设置较为敏感。 为了实现可控的生成，这些方法总是需要反复求解和调整参数（Jiang et al., 2016；Macklin et al., 2016；Modi et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2024；Tan et al., 2024）。 相比之下，学习到的物理先验提供了一种更具扩展性的替代方案（Wang et al., 2025b），但多相场景引入了一个根本性的建模挑战：不同相表现出不同的动态特性，而它们的演化又通过物理相互作用相互耦合（Zhang et al., 2026c；Tao et al., 2026）。 固体可能表现出刚性或可变形运动，而气体则涉及速度输运、耗散、压力和浮力（Stomakhin et al., 2013；Macklin et al., 2016；Modi et al., 2024；Thuerey & Pfaff, 2018；Ummenhofer et al., 2020；Winchenbach & Thuerey, 2024；Baumgarten et al., 2021）。 因此，一个合适的模型需要在保留各相特定动态的同时，明确捕捉相之间的相互作用。

paragraphs.en: We present PAVG ( Phase-Aware Video Generation ), a framework for physics-grounded video generation of single-phase motion and solid–gas interactions. Given an initial image and an external intervention, PAVG lifts the image to phase-specific 3D point representations and predicts their future trajectories, which are then injected into a pretrained video generator as motion controls. Instead of performing online physical simulation, PAVG learns physical trajectory priors directly from data. Its dual-branch architecture separately models solid and gas dynamics, while spatiotemporal cross-attention couples the branches to capture their interactions. We further employ a two-stage training strategy, first learning single-phase motion priors and then cross-phase interactions. To support this setting, we construct a dataset covering diverse solid, gas, and solid–gas interaction scenarios. Experiments demonstrate that PAVG achieves better motion adherence, greater physical plausibility, and higher video quality than other approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 PAVG（Phase-Aware Video Generation），一个基于物理原理的视频生成框架，用于生成单相运动和固气相互作用场景。 给定初始图像和外部干预，PAVG 将图像提升至特定相的三维点表示，并预测其未来轨迹，随后将这些轨迹注入预训练的视频生成器中作为运动控制信号。 PAVG 不执行在线物理模拟，而是直接从数据中学习物理轨迹的先验知识。 其双分支架构分别对固体和气体动力学进行建模，而时空交叉注意力则将两个分支耦合起来以捕捉相互作用。 我们进一步采用两阶段训练策略：首先学习单相运动先验，然后学习跨相相互作用。 为支持这一设定，我们构建了一个涵盖多样化固体、气体及固气相互作用场景的数据集。 实验表明，PAVG 在运动贴合度、物理合理性以及视频质量方面均优于其他方法。

paragraphs.en: We propose PAVG ( Phase-Aware Video Generation ), a framework for physics-grounded dynamics and interactions that models single-phase motion and solid–gas interaction through a shared point-trajectory interface for physically controllable video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 PAVG（Phase-Aware Video Generation，即“相感知视频生成”），这是一个基于物理的动力学与交互框架，通过共享的点轨迹接口对单相运动和固气相互作用进行建模，从而实现具有物理可控性的视频生成。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a dual-branch trajectory predictor with spatiotemporal cross-attention to capture solid-gas interactions while supporting both single- and cross-phase motion prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种具有时空交叉注意力的双分支轨迹预测器，用于捕捉固气相互作用，同时支持单相和跨相运动预测。

paragraphs.en: We construct a trajectory dataset and a held-out benchmark covering diverse single-phase motions and solid–gas interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了一个轨迹数据集和一个预留的基准数据集，涵盖了多种单阶段运动和固气相互作用。

paragraphs.en: We systematically evaluate trajectory prediction and video generation across single-phase and cross-phase settings, demonstrating better adherence to motion instructions, greater physical plausibility, and higher video quality.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在单阶段和跨阶段设置中，对轨迹预测和视频生成进行了系统性评估，结果表明其能更好地遵循运动指令、具有更高的物理合理性，并生成更高质量的视频。

paragraphs.en: Controllable video generation augments general-purpose video models ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Team Wan et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) with object, region, or multi-entity motion controls ( Yin et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Geng et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Fu et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024a ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2025c ; Li et al., 2025b ) , including point trajectories ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2026f ; Chu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026c ) , 3D-aware conditions ( Wang et al., 2025c ; Chen et al., 2025c ; Gu et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , and structured guidance ( Choo et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026a ) . Recent work also models passive or rigid-body responses ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Romero et al., 2026 ) . PAVG instead predicts phase-specific trajectories from material properties and applied forces before synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 可控视频生成通过为通用视频模型（Wu 等人，2025；Team Wan 等人，2025；Yang 等人，2024）添加对象、区域或多实体运动控制（Yin 等人，2023；Wang 等人，2024b；Geng 等人，2025；Zhang 等人，2025a；Fu 等人，2024；Wu 等人，2024；Wang 等人，2024a；Zhang 等人，2025b；Li 等人，2025c；Li 等人，2025b），包括点轨迹（Wang 等人，2025a；Zhang 等人，2026f；Chu 等人，2025；Li 等人，2026c）、3D感知条件（Wang 等人，2025c；Chen 等人，2025c；Gu 等人，2025；Zheng 等人，2026；Zhang 等人，2026a）以及结构化引导（Choo 等人，2026；Chen 等人，2026b；Chen 等人，2026a），从而增强了模型能力。 近期的研究还模拟了被动或刚体响应（Liu 等人，2026；Romero 等人，2026）。 PAVG 则在合成之前，根据材料属性和施加的力预测特定相位的轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Physical dynamics models use material points, grids, particles, or graphs to represent phase-dependent states ( Jiang et al., 2016 ; Stomakhin et al., 2013 ; Macklin et al., 2016 ; Modi et al., 2024 ; Thuerey & Pfaff, 2018 ; Battaglia et al., 2016 ; Li et al., 2019 ; Sanchez-Gonzalez et al., 2020 ; Pfaff et al., 2021 ; Feng et al., 2025b ) . Fluid predictors incorporate continuous convolutions or equivariance ( Ummenhofer et al., 2020 ; Winchenbach & Thuerey, 2024 ; Toshev et al., 2023 ) , while latent motion priors model non-rigid motion ( Tevet et al., 2023 ; Cao et al., 2024 ; Ji et al., 2025 ) . Recent work learns physical parameters and dynamics from videos ( Garcia et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Zhao et al., 2025b ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Quan et al., 2026 ; Perini et al., 2026 ) or predicts scene and object trajectories ( Zhang et al., 2026e ; Soraki et al., 2026 ) ; PhysCtrl and equation-based forecasting connect trajectory prediction to video generation ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Feng et al., 2025a ) . HGATSolver, Fisale, and CFC explicitly couple distinct physical domains ( Zhang et al., 2026c ; Tao et al., 2026 ; Dou et al., 2025 ) . PAVG instead learns fixed-identity point trajectories for video control across single-phase motion and solid–gas interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 物理动力学模型使用材料点、网格、粒子或图来表示与相相关的状态（Jiang 等，2016；Stomakhin 等，2013；Macklin 等，2016；Modi 等，2024；Thuerey & Pfaff，2018；Battaglia 等，2016；Li 等，2019；Sanchez-Gonzalez 等，2020；Pfaff 等，2021；Feng 等，2025b）。 流体预测器采用连续卷积或等变性（Ummenhofer 等，2020；Winchenbach & Thuerey，2024；Toshev 等，2023），而潜在运动先验则对非刚性运动进行建模（Tevet 等，2023；Cao 等，2024；Ji 等，2025）。 近期研究通过视频学习物理参数和动力学特性（Garcia 等，2025；Chen 等，2025b；Zhao 等，2025b；Gao 等，2025；Li 等，2025a；Quan 等，2026；Perini 等，2026），或预测场景和物体轨迹（Zhang 等，2026e；Soraki 等，2026）；PhysCtrl 和基于方程的预测方法则将轨迹预测与视频生成联系起来（Wang 等，2025b；Feng 等，2025a）。 HGATSolver、Fisale 和 CFC 显式地将不同的物理域耦合在一起（Zhang 等，2026c；Tao 等，2026；Dou 等，2025）。 PAVG 则学习具有固定身份的点轨迹，以实现跨单相运动和固-气相互作用的视频控制。

paragraphs.en: PAVG couples two phase-specific point-cloud diffusion branches with spatiotemporal attention ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . Spatial and temporal cross-phase interaction (CPI) modules connect the branches while preserving phase-specific dynamics (Figure 3 ). Given phase regions and physical controls (e.g., material properties and applied forces), we assume negligible gas feedback on solid motion and transfer solid context only to gas. Because interaction requires position- and state-dependent cross-phase context while preserving phase-specific dynamics and Stage-1 priors, we use directional, gated residual cross-attention. CPI factorizes this exchange into spatial and temporal updates, avoiding full joint attention over all points and frames.
paragraphs.zh: PAVG 将两个特定于各相的点云扩散分支与时空注意力机制相结合（Wang 等人，2025b）。 空间与时间跨相交互（CPI）模块在连接各分支的同时，保留了各相特有的动态特性（图 3）。 在给定的相区域和物理控制参数（例如材料特性和施加的力）下，我们假设气体对固体运动的影响可忽略不计，并且仅将固体上下文信息传递至气体。 由于交互需要依赖位置和状态的跨相上下文信息，同时必须保留各相特有的动态特性以及第一阶段先验知识，因此我们采用有方向、带门控的残差跨注意力机制。 CPI 将这种信息交换分解为空间更新和时间更新，从而避免对所有点和所有帧进行完整的联合注意力计算。

paragraphs.en: Video generation. We assemble a benchmark of 32 scenes covering single-phase motion and solid–gas interaction: eight solid, eight gas, and sixteen solid–gas cases. paragraphs.en: SFBC and DLF predict gas dynamics autoregressively rather than modeling full fixed-identity trajectories; on solids, PhysCtrl outperforms the latent-motion baselines MDM and Motion2VecSets. For interactions, GNS, HGATSolver, and Fisale use autoregressive updates with particle-type message passing, heterogeneous attention, and latent ALE grids, respectively ( Sanchez-Gonzalez et al., 2020 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Tao et al., 2026 ) . PAVG instead jointly denoises all future frames with phase-specific spatiotemporal Transformers and solid-to-gas CPI, preserving within-phase dynamics and cross-phase influence in a shared trajectory space.
paragraphs.zh: SFBC 和 DLF 通过自回归方式预测气体动力学，而非对完整的固定身份轨迹进行建模；在固体方面，PhysCtrl 的表现优于潜在运动基线方法 MDM 和 Motion2VecSets。 对于相互作用，GNS、HGATSolver 和 Fisale 分别采用自回归更新，并结合粒子类型消息传递、异构注意力和潜在 ALE 网格（Sanchez-Gonzalez 等人，2020；Zhang 等人，2026c；Tao 等人，2026）。 PAVG 则通过相特定的时空 Transformer 和固体到气体的 CPI，联合去除所有未来帧的噪声，在共享的轨迹空间中保留相内动力学和跨相影响。

paragraphs.en: With matched per-phase exposure, specialists outperform Unified on all three metrics for both phases. Relative to Unified, Solid-only improves solid vIoU by 3.02%, while Gas-only improves gas vIoU by 10.63% and reduces CD and Corr by 35.43% and 28.86%, respectively. paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduced PAVG ( Phase-Aware Video Generation ), a framework for physics-grounded dynamics and interactions. PAVG explicitly separates the distinct dynamics of solids and gases through a dual-branch trajectory predictor, while spatiotemporal cross-attention captures the physical coupling between phases. By learning physical trajectory priors from the proposed large-scale trajectory corpus, PAVG enables efficient and controllable video generation under external physical interventions. Experiments across single-phase and solid-gas interaction scenarios show consistent improvements in motion adherence, physical plausibility, and visual quality. We hope this work provides a step toward more general physics-grounded video generation models capable of reasoning about heterogeneous physical dynamics and their interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 PAVG（相位感知视频生成），一个基于物理原理的动力学及相互作用框架。 PAVG 通过双分支轨迹预测器明确分离固体和气体的不同动力学特性，同时时空交叉注意力机制能够捕捉不同相态之间的物理耦合。 通过从我们提出的大规模轨迹语料库中学习物理轨迹先验知识，PAVG 能够在外部物理干预下实现高效且可控的视频生成。 在单相场景以及固体-气体相互作用场景中的实验表明，该方法在运动一致性、物理合理性和视觉质量方面均表现出持续改进。 我们希望这项工作能为开发更通用的基于物理原理的视频生成模型提供进展，这些模型能够推理异质物理动力学及其相互作用。

paragraphs.en: We generate solid trajectories following PhysCtrl’s asset curation and simulation methodology ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , rather than importing its complete trajectory dataset. The source geometry consists of ObjaverseXL assets selected by TRELLIS-500K. Objects are normalized, randomly oriented, and sampled with farthest-point sampling to obtain the control-point representation. Material assignments produce elastic, plasticine, sand, and rigid examples using the solvers in Appendix A.1 . For deformable materials, the generation recipe samples log 10 ⁡ E \log_{10}E uniformly from [ 4 , 7 ] [4,7] and Poisson’s ratio ν \nu from [ 0.05 , 0.45 ] [0.05,0.45] . Elastic examples include localized-force and gravity-driven motion, whereas plasticine, sand, and rigid examples form gravity-driven subsets. Localized-force conditions record the application point, affected-point mask, and force vector; gravity examples record the gravity flag and floor height. Rigid trajectories apply the simulated object transform to fixed body-space sample points. Exports contain positions, velocities, material labels, physical conditions, and, where defined by MPM, deformation gradients, affine velocity matrices, and point volumes.

paragraphs.en: Gas initialization draws on OpenVDB/JangaFX and WildSmoke assets to obtain a spatial concentration distribution and an initial tracer cloud. These assets supply initial states; subsequent motion is generated under the prescribed controls using the MantaFlow procedure in Appendix A.2 . We vary the initial gas support, orientation, and velocity condition while retaining 2,048 tracer identities. The random-motion generation recipe samples an isotropic direction and a speed from a Gaussian with mean 2.0 2.0 and standard deviation 0.4 0.4 , truncated to [ 0.8 , 3.2 ] [0.8,3.2] in its normalized coordinates. The global initial-motion descriptor is supplemented by spatial expansion, swirl, and smooth perturbations to form a nonuniform initial velocity field. It is not a continuously applied external force. The corresponding recipe uses a 28 × 36 × 28 28\times 36\times 28 gas grid and 48 evolution intervals of 0.05 0.05 , with the initial state stored separately. Continuous source emission and imposed domain wind are disabled in this single-gas recipe, so the rollout evolves the existing gas support. The exporter records positions, sampled velocities, concentration weights, and validity flags before the learning-time frame selection.
paragraphs.zh: 气体初始化利用 OpenVDB/JangaFX 和 WildSmoke 资产，以获得空间浓度分布和初始示踪云。 这些资产提供初始状态；后续运动则在预设控制下，通过附录 A.2 中的 MantaFlow 流程生成。 我们在保持 2,048 个示踪体身份的同时，调整了初始气体支撑、方向和速度条件。 随机运动生成方案从各向同性的方向和一个均值为 2.0 2.0、标准差为 0.4 0.4 的高斯分布中采样速度，并在归一化坐标中将其截断至 [ 0.8 , 3.2 ] [0.8,3.2]。 全局初始运动描述符通过空间扩展、涡旋和平滑扰动进行补充，从而形成非均匀的初始速度场。 它并非一种持续施加的外部力。 相应的方案使用一个 28 × 36 × 28 28\times 36\times 28 的气体网格和 48 个时长为 0.05 0.05 的演化区间，初始状态则单独存储。 在此单气体方案中，连续源发射和域内强制风均被禁用，因此演化过程仅对现有的气体支撑进行发展。 在训练阶段的帧选择之前，导出器会记录位置、采样速度、浓度权重和有效性标志。

paragraphs.en: Interaction examples combine a simulated solid rollout with a gas initial state in a shared spatial domain. The solid positions and velocities are replayed at the gas solver’s recorded times, while the initial gas support is aligned relative to the solid or its contact plane. MantaFlow advances the gas with the local transfer and collision updates in Appendix A.3 . Both point streams are exported together with their physical conditions and phase-presence flags. Additional gas diagnostics record the total velocity change, the applied solid-induced velocity increment, and tracer validity. These diagnostics provide the supervision region and scale used by the interaction constraint; they are not obtained by subtracting two independently simulated trajectories. The solid and gas streams of one interaction remain together when assigning that sample to a dataset partition.

paragraphs.en: Each scene specifies an initial image, selected phase regions, numerical motion conditions, and a textual motion description. paragraphs.en: Each PAVG branch uses eight spatiotemporal Transformer blocks, a 256-dimensional latent space, and four attention heads. The interaction gates are initialized to zero, and solid context is detached when read by the gas branch. Inputs include the initial geometry, pointwise initial velocity and action mask, point volumes, and force, material, and boundary descriptors. paragraphs.en: The Stage 1 comparison in Table 3 uses the same single-branch implementation and condition encoding for separate and unified predictors. The training sets contain 508,100 solid and 99,800 gas sequences, with no interaction data used in this comparison. Each phase-specific predictor is trained only on its own phase for 60K updates with a global batch size of 32, corresponding to 1.92 million training examples. The unified predictor is trained from scratch on both sets, with its cumulative training exposure on each phase matched to that of the corresponding phase-specific predictor: 1.92 million solid examples and 1.92 million gas examples. Solid and gas data are mixed throughout training rather than processed in consecutive phase-specific stages. A deterministic sampler randomly selects and orders two solid and two gas examples in every local batch; with 24 GPUs and no gradient accumulation, each update contains 48 examples from each phase (global batch size 96). Thus, 40K successful updates match the per-phase sample budget of the two separate 60K-update runs. This corresponds to approximately 3.78 nominal epochs over the solid set and 19.24 over the gas set, matching each phase to its own baseline rather than equating epoch counts across phases. Both settings apply the same phase-specific objectives: deformation and floor constraints on applicable solid samples and the divergence constraint on gas samples, without an advection loss.

sents.en: Where a nonuniform initial field is required, the initializer maps a training-only gas initial state to the target support and prescribed direction; it does not use future trajectories from that sample.
sents.zh: 当需要非均匀初始场时，初始化器会将仅用于训练的气体初始状态映射到目标支撑区域和预定方向；它不会使用该样本的未来轨迹。

sents.en: These numerical conditions are not estimated from the single image.
sents.zh: 这些数值条件并非从单张图像中估计得出。

paragraphs.en: A reconstruction-based initialization is also supported for selected solid regions: rembg and SAM ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) isolate the object, SV3D ( Voleti et al., 2024 ) provides additional views, and LGM ( Tang et al., 2024 ) reconstructs a representation from which points are sampled. This optional path is distinct from the mask-derived benchmark initialization, whose results do not establish full volumetric gas reconstruction.
paragraphs.zh: 对于选定的实体区域，也支持基于重建的初始化：rembg 和 SAM（Kirillov 等，2023）用于隔离物体，SV3D（Voleti 等，2024）提供额外视角，而 LGM（Tang 等，2024）则重建一个表示，并从中采样点。 这一可选路径与基于掩码的基准初始化不同，后者的结果并未实现完整的体容积气体重建。

paragraphs.en: We encode the initial point clouds and numerical conditions using the same phase ordering and normalization as the training inputs. PAVG samples all 24 future frames jointly, starting from Gaussian noise and applying 25 DDIM updates. The video-benchmark trajectory runs use a fixed sampling seed of 42 and guidance scale of 1.0. Single-phase inputs activate the corresponding branch; interaction inputs activate both branches and the learned interaction pathway. The initial cloud remains fixed throughout denoising, and the returned coordinates are clean absolute positions rather than Eulerian fields. Neither the text prompt nor future ground-truth motion is supplied to PAVG.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用与训练输入相同的相位排序和归一化方法对初始点云和数值条件进行编码。 PAVG 从高斯噪声出发，通过 25 次 DDIM 更新，联合采样所有 24 个未来帧。 视频基准轨迹运行使用固定的采样种子 42 和指导尺度 1.0。 单相位输入会激活对应的分支；交互输入则会同时激活两个分支以及已学习的交互路径。 在整个去噪过程中，初始点云保持固定，而返回的坐标是干净的绝对位置，而非欧拉场。 PAVG 既没有接收到文本提示，也没有接收到未来的真实运动数据。

paragraphs.en: For the mask-derived initialization, the stored inverse transform maps predicted positions back to pixel coordinates, with model depth retained in the track representation. The reconstruction-based path instead uses its camera projection. The current DaS adapter constructs 49 track frames from the initial cloud and the 24 forecasts: it inserts midpoints between successive forecasts and repeats the last endpoint. This is a temporal control encoding, not a new physical simulation or an assertion that every video backbone follows the same physical clock. Image-space control anchors inside each phase mask are assigned to nearby projected points; anchors outside the moving regions remain fixed, and out-of-frame tracks are marked invisible. The two phase streams are merged into one tracking condition rather than synthesized as separate videos. Pretrained DaS ( Gu et al., 2025 ) , using the cogshader5B checkpoint, receives the clean initial image, merged tracking condition, and scene text. The video-synthesis components are frozen and are not optimized during PAVG training. The 32-scene video evaluation samples each frozen generated clip as described in Appendix C.5 ; export FPS does not redefine the trajectory solver’s stored-frame intervals.
paragraphs.zh: 对于基于掩码的初始化，存储的反向变换将预测位置映射回像素坐标，同时保留模型深度在轨迹表示中。 而基于重建的路径则使用其自身的相机投影。 当前的 DaS 适配器从初始点云和 24 个预测中构建 49 个轨迹帧：它在连续预测之间插入中点，并重复最后一个端点。 这是一种时间控制编码，而非新的物理模拟，也不是断言每个视频骨干网络都遵循相同的物理时钟。 每个相位掩码内的图像空间控制锚点被分配给附近的投影点；移动区域外的锚点保持固定，而画面外的轨迹则被标记为不可见。 两个相位流被合并为一个跟踪条件，而不是合成成独立的视频。 预训练的 DaS（Gu et al., 2025）使用 cogshader5B 检查点，接收干净的初始图像、合并后的跟踪条件以及场景文本。 视频合成组件在 PAVG 训练期间被冻结，不会进行优化。 32 个场景的视频评估按照附录 C.5 中所述对每个冻结的生成片段进行采样；导出帧率不会重新定义轨迹求解器存储的帧间隔。

paragraphs.en: The gas-only comparison assigns SFBC, DLF, and SEGNN to gas training and test data; the solid-only comparison assigns PhysCtrl, MDM, and Motion2VecSets to solid training and test data. The single-phase rows refer to phase-specific training, rather than subset scores from a combined model. For the solid-only comparison, MDM and Motion2VecSets are adapted to predict point trajectories from initial geometry and physical conditions, following the baseline setup in PhysCtrl ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . The overall comparison evaluates the single-solid, single-gas, and paired solid–gas sets, with GNS, HGATSolver, and Fisale trained on their union under the mixed protocol. The comparison fixes the available initial geometry and physical conditions and excludes ground-truth future states from inference inputs. The resulting comparison concerns task-adapted implementations under fixed data splits and metrics, not the original methods in their native problem settings.
paragraphs.zh: 仅气体比较将 SFBC、DLF 和 SEGNN 分配给气体训练和测试数据；仅固体比较将 PhysCtrl、MDM 和 Motion2VecSets 分配给固体训练和测试数据。 单相行指的是针对特定相的训练，而非来自组合模型的子集得分。 在仅固体的比较中，MDM 和 Motion2VecSets 被调整用于根据初始几何形状和物理条件预测点轨迹，遵循 PhysCtrl（Wang 等人，2025b）中的基线设置。 整体比较评估了单固体、单气体以及成对的固体–气体数据集，其中 GNS、HGATSolver 和 Fisale 在混合协议下基于这些数据集的并集进行训练。 该比较固定了可用的初始几何形状和物理条件，并且未将真实未来状态纳入推理输入。 由此产生的比较关注的是在固定数据划分和指标下的任务适配实现，而非原始方法在其原生问题设置中的表现。

paragraphs.en: Baselines retain method-specific architectures and training budgets. The MDM configuration uses eight layers, 256 latent dimensions, and 60K updates, while Motion2VecSets uses 60K autoencoder updates followed by 60K diffusion updates, with a global batch size of 32 in both stages. HGATSolver is trained for 60K updates with a global batch size of 16 and seed 42, and its checkpoint is selected by validation performance. Fisale is trained for 60K updates with a global batch size of 24 and seed 42, and its checkpoint is selected by validation performance. Autoregressive predictors roll out from the initial state without teacher-forcing future targets, while sequence predictors output the evaluation horizon jointly.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法保留各自特定的架构和训练预算。 MDM 配置使用八层、256 个潜在维度和 60K 次更新，而 Motion2VecSets 则先进行 60K 次自编码器更新，再进行 60K 次扩散更新，两个阶段均采用 32 的全局批量大小。 HGATSolver 以 16 的全局批量大小和种子值 42 进行 60K 次更新训练，其检查点通过验证性能选择。 Fisale 以 24 的全局批量大小和种子值 42 进行 60K 次更新训练，其检查点通过验证性能选择。 自回归预测器从初始状态开始展开，且不通过教师强制法引入未来目标；而序列预测器则联合输出整个评估时域的结果。

paragraphs.en: The interaction-pathway comparison uses the same two-stage-trained model and disables only the solid-to-gas cross-attention updates at inference. The interaction-constraint study instead changes the coupling-loss coefficient during training while retaining the architecture and evaluation protocol. paragraphs.en: All video methods receive the same clean initial image; the shared motion description is supplied only to methods with a text interface. PAVG and the PhysCtrl baseline additionally receive numerical physical conditions for trajectory prediction, whereas Force Prompting and StreamForce receive controls through their native force interfaces. The general-purpose baselines receive image and text conditions only. For motion-controlled baselines, frozen trajectories from the PAVG control pipeline are converted into phase-wise masks and box trajectories for FlashMotion, point tracks and visibility for Wan-Move, phase-wise representative trajectories and masks for DragAnything, and a merged-entity representative trajectory and mask for ObjCtrl-2.5D. For ObjCtrl-2.5D, the initial image is also used to estimate depth, and the merged trajectory is converted into camera poses using the released implementation. We evaluate its merged-entity adapter rather than the multi-object extension demonstrated in its paper; this aggregation cannot preserve independent solid and gas motion. These baselines evaluate alternative video synthesis backends under trajectory guidance. Their frozen videos are retained when the PAVG and PhysCtrl videos are updated, so their control trajectories are not assumed to be identical to those in the updated PAVG release. Method-native negative prompts and inference settings are not treated as additional shared physical inputs. The annotated condition image is supplied to the evaluator, not substituted for the clean generation input.

paragraphs.en: PAVG uses its full Stage 2 model. For PhysCtrl, we use a checkpoint trained on the solid training split of our dataset for 60K updates with a task-adapted eight-layer, 256-dimensional Transformer and a global batch size of 32. Training uses AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay of 10 − 2 10^{-2} , cosine decay, and 100 warmup updates. This PhysCtrl video checkpoint differs from the one used for trajectory evaluation in Table 2 . For solid–gas scenes, the PhysCtrl adapter jointly predicts 2,048 points (1,024 solid and 1,024 gas) in one pass, supplying gas velocity as per-point initial velocity rather than an external force. This is an adaptation of the solid-trained predictor to gas and interaction inputs, not a gas-trained PhysCtrl model. Both methods use seed 42 for trajectory sampling and video generation and produce 49-frame clips at 720 × 480 720\times 480 resolution and 8 FPS.
paragraphs.zh: PAVG 使用其完整的阶段 2 模型。 对于 PhysCtrl，我们使用在数据集的固体训练子集上经过 60,000 次更新的检查点，该检查点采用任务自适应的八层、256 维 Transformer 和 32 的全局批量大小。 训练使用 AdamW，学习率为 10⁻⁴，权重衰减为 10⁻²，采用余弦衰减和 100 次预热更新。 这个 PhysCtrl 视频检查点不同于表 2 中用于轨迹评估的检查点。 对于固体-气体场景，PhysCtrl 适配器在一次通过中联合预测 2,048 个点（1,024 个固体点和 1,024 个气体点），并将气体速度作为每个点的初始速度提供，而非外部力。 这是将固体训练预测器适配到气体和交互输入的结果，而不是一个经过气体训练的 PhysCtrl 模型。 两种方法在轨迹采样和视频生成时都使用种子 42，并以 720×480 分辨率和 8 FPS 生成 49 帧的视频片段。

paragraphs.en: Score each criterion independently on a five-point Likert scale (1 = poor, 5 = excellent). Inspect all ten samples across all four sheets before scoring. Track displacement, orientation, support contact, and gas against stable landmarks through early, middle, and late samples, accounting for camera motion. Small, gradual, or out-and-back motion is not no motion; do not judge from one frame or only the endpoints. If motion is unclear at the supplied resolution, state uncertainty rather than claiming that nothing moves.
paragraphs.zh: 对每个标准独立地在五点李克特量表上进行评分（1 = 差，5 = 优秀）。 在评分前，请检查所有四张表格中的全部十个样本。 通过早期、中期和后期的样本，结合相机运动的影响，追踪位移、方向、支撑接触和气体相对于稳定参照点的变化。 微小、渐进或往返运动并非没有运动；不要仅根据单帧画面或仅根据端点来判断。 如果在提供的分辨率下运动不清晰，应说明存在不确定性，而不是声称没有任何物体移动。

sents.zh: 对每个标准独立地在五点李克特量表上进行评分（1 = 差，5 = 优秀）。

sents.en: Inspect all ten samples across all four sheets before scoring.
sents.zh: 在评分前，请检查所有四张表格中的全部十个样本。

sents.en: Track displacement, orientation, support contact, and gas against stable landmarks through early, middle, and late samples, accounting for camera motion.

sents.en: Small, gradual, or out-and-back motion is not no motion; do not judge from one frame or only the endpoints.
sents.zh: 微小、渐进或往返运动并非没有运动；不要仅根据单帧画面或仅根据端点来判断。

sents.en: If motion is unclear at the supplied resolution, state uncertainty rather than claiming that nothing moves.
sents.zh: 如果在提供的分辨率下运动不清晰，应说明存在不确定性，而不是声称没有任何物体移动。

paragraphs.en: Semantic Adherence (SA): How well content and motion match the text prompt, especially the force direction and position. The video should start from the input image. For gas, check the specified motion and interaction and trace later clouds to initial gas or a scene/prompt-supported source. Substantial new clouds or abrupt replacement without a plausible origin are errors even when their direction is correct. Normal deformation, diffusion, splitting, and emergence from occlusion need not preserve the initial silhouette.
paragraphs.zh: 语义一致性（SA）：内容运动与文本提示的匹配程度，尤其是力的方向和位置。 视频应从输入图像开始。 对于气体，需检查指定的运动和交互，并追溯后续云团至初始气体或由场景/提示支持的来源。 即使方向正确，出现大量新云团或突兀替换且无合理来源的情况也属于错误。 正常的形变、扩散、分裂以及从遮挡中显现出的形态无需保留初始轮廓。

sents.en: Semantic Adherence (SA): How well content and motion match the text prompt, especially the force direction and position.
sents.zh: 语义一致性（SA）：内容运动与文本提示的匹配程度，尤其是力的方向和位置。

sents.en: The video should start from the input image.
sents.zh: 视频应从输入图像开始。

sents.en: For gas, check the specified motion and interaction and trace later clouds to initial gas or a scene/prompt-supported source.
sents.zh: 对于气体，需检查指定的运动和交互，并追溯后续云团至初始气体或由场景/提示支持的来源。

sents.en: Substantial new clouds or abrupt replacement without a plausible origin are errors even when their direction is correct.
sents.zh: 即使方向正确，出现大量新云团或突兀替换且无合理来源的情况也属于错误。

sents.en: Normal deformation, diffusion, splitting, and emergence from occlusion need not preserve the initial silhouette.
sents.zh: 正常的形变、扩散、分裂以及从遮挡中显现出的形态无需保留初始轮廓。

paragraphs.en: Physical Commonsense (PC): Whether motion is physically plausible given the force direction and application point. Consider translation and torque about the center of mass or relevant support/pivot. Penalize clearly missing or opposite rotation when expected and visible, but not plausible torque-driven tilt. Do not require rotation when gravity, contact, constraints, or a negligible moment arm explain its absence; state uncertainty for ambiguous geometry. For gas, assess plausible transport, deformation, spreading, and solid–gas interaction from the initial conditions. Penalize unsupported gas creation, solid-like behavior, and sticker-like translation that preserves the gas shape and internal pattern throughout without plausible evolution or interaction. Bulk advection alone is not an error, and dramatic turbulence is not required.
paragraphs.zh: 物理常识（PC）：在给定力的方向和作用点的情况下，判断运动是否在物理上合理。 需考虑围绕质心或相关支撑点/旋转轴的平移和扭矩。 若预期且可见的旋转明显缺失或方向相反，则予以扣分；但由扭矩驱动的合理倾斜除外。 若重力、接触力、约束条件或可忽略的力臂足以解释旋转的缺失，则无需要求存在旋转；对于几何结构不明确的情况，应说明不确定性。 对于气体，需根据初始条件评估其合理的输运、形变、扩散以及固-气相互作用。 若出现无依据的气体生成、类固体行为，或类似贴纸的平移（在整个过程中保持气体的形状和内部模式不变，且缺乏合理的演化或相互作用），则予以扣分。 仅存在整体平流本身并非错误，也不要求出现剧烈的湍流。

sents.zh: 物理常识（PC）：在给定力的方向和作用点的情况下，判断运动是否在物理上合理。

sents.zh: 对于气体，需根据初始条件评估其合理的输运、形变、扩散以及固-气相互作用。

sents.en: Penalize unsupported gas creation, solid-like behavior, and sticker-like translation that preserves the gas shape and internal pattern throughout without plausible evolution or interaction.
sents.zh: 若出现无依据的气体生成、类固体行为，或类似贴纸的平移（在整个过程中保持气体的形状和内部模式不变，且缺乏合理的演化或相互作用），则予以扣分。

sents.en: Bulk advection alone is not an error, and dramatic turbulence is not required.
sents.zh: 仅存在整体平流本身并非错误，也不要求出现剧烈的湍流。

paragraphs.en: Video Quality (VQ): Overall visual and temporal quality; static or nearly-static sequences are less preferred. Assess visible artifacts and discontinuities independently: smooth rendering does not excuse semantic or physical errors.
paragraphs.zh: 视频质量（VQ）：整体视觉和时序质量；静态或近乎静态的序列不太受青睐。 独立评估可见的人工痕迹和不连续性：流畅的渲染并不能掩盖语义或物理错误。

sents.en: Video Quality (VQ): Overall visual and temporal quality; static or nearly-static sequences are less preferred.
sents.zh: 视频质量（VQ）：整体视觉和时序质量；静态或近乎静态的序列不太受青睐。

sents.en: Assess visible artifacts and discontinuities independently: smooth rendering does not excuse semantic or physical errors.
sents.zh: 独立评估可见的人工痕迹和不连续性：流畅的渲染并不能掩盖语义或物理错误。

paragraphs.en: Return a JSON object containing a videos array with exactly eleven entries. Each contains video , a concise Chinese observed_motion summary of early-to-middle-to-late changes, and SA , PC , and VQ objects. Each criterion contains a brief Chinese reason , one to four supporting sample numbers in samples , and an integer score from 1 to 5. Support motion or stillness claims with early and late samples, checking intermediate samples too.
paragraphs.zh: 返回一个 JSON 对象，其中包含一个 videos 数组，且该数组恰好有十一项。 每一项都包含 video、对早期至中期至晚期变化的简洁中文 observed_motion 摘要，以及 SA、PC 和 VQ 对象。 每个标准都包含一个简短的中文原因、一到四个用于支持判断的 samples 中的样本编号，以及一个从 1 到 5 的整数分数。 使用早期和晚期的样本来支持关于运动或静止的主张，同时检查中间样本。

sents.zh: 返回一个 JSON 对象，其中包含一个 videos 数组，且该数组恰好有十一项。

sents.en: Each contains video , a concise Chinese observed_motion summary of early-to-middle-to-late changes, and SA , PC , and VQ objects.
sents.zh: 每一项都包含 video、对早期至中期至晚期变化的简洁中文 observed_motion 摘要，以及 SA、PC 和 VQ 对象。

sents.en: Each criterion contains a brief Chinese reason , one to four supporting sample numbers in samples , and an integer score from 1 to 5.

sents.zh: 使用早期和晚期的样本来支持关于运动或静止的主张，同时检查中间样本。

paragraphs.en: No prompt specifies a preferred method, a required ranking, or a target score distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 没有任何提示指定了首选方法、必需的排序或目标分数分布。

paragraphs.en: These ratings measure perceived adherence, plausibility, and quality, not physical ground truth. Finite temporal sampling and image resizing can obscure subtle motion or artifacts. Uniform sampling compares visible progression; it does not establish equal physical speeds across backbones with different native temporal settings. The scores characterize this frozen video release and rubric, and should not be treated as directly comparable to ratings from earlier releases.
paragraphs.zh: 这些评分衡量的是感知到的遵循程度、合理性和质量，而非物理上的真实情况。 有限的时域采样和图像缩放可能会掩盖细微的运动或伪影。 均匀采样比较的是可见的进展过程；它并未证明具有不同原生时域设置的骨骼之间具有相同的物理速度。 这些分数反映了当前这一版视频发布和评分标准的特点，不应被视为与早期版本中的评分直接可比。

sents.en: These ratings measure perceived adherence, plausibility, and quality, not physical ground truth.
sents.zh: 这些评分衡量的是感知到的遵循程度、合理性和质量，而非物理上的真实情况。

sents.zh: 有限的时域采样和图像缩放可能会掩盖细微的运动或伪影。

sents.en: Uniform sampling compares visible progression; it does not establish equal physical speeds across backbones with different native temporal settings.

paragraphs.en: We conducted a user study to evaluate the physics plausibility and overall quality of videos generated by PAVG and ten baselines. Each participant evaluated 32 scenes, each containing an annotated input image, a text prompt describing the scene and physical conditions, and eleven generated results presented as two-second looping GIFs. Red arrows indicate forces on solids, while blue arrows indicate gas initial velocities. Arrow tails mark the force application point or initial-velocity annotation location, and arrowheads indicate the corresponding direction. Scene and method orders were randomized, with method identities hidden.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了一项用户研究，以评估 PAVG 和十种基线模型所生成视频的物理合理性及整体质量。 每位参与者都评估了 32 个场景，每个场景均包含一张带标注的输入图像、一段描述场景和物理条件的文本提示，以及以两秒循环 GIF 形式呈现的十一个生成结果。 红色箭头表示固体所受的力，而蓝色箭头则表示气体的初始速度。 箭尾标记了力的作用点或初始速度的标注位置，箭头则指向相应的方向。 场景和模型方法的顺序均经过随机排列，且模型方法的具体身份被隐藏。

sents.en: We conducted a user study to evaluate the physics plausibility and overall quality of videos generated by PAVG and ten baselines.
sents.zh: 我们进行了一项用户研究，以评估 PAVG 和十种基线模型所生成视频的物理合理性及整体质量。

sents.en: Each participant evaluated 32 scenes, each containing an annotated input image, a text prompt describing the scene and physical conditions, and eleven generated results presented as two-second looping GIFs.
sents.zh: 每位参与者都评估了 32 个场景，每个场景均包含一张带标注的输入图像、一段描述场景和物理条件的文本提示，以及以两秒循环 GIF 形式呈现的十一个生成结果。

sents.en: Red arrows indicate forces on solids, while blue arrows indicate gas initial velocities.
sents.zh: 红色箭头表示固体所受的力，而蓝色箭头则表示气体的初始速度。

sents.en: Arrow tails mark the force application point or initial-velocity annotation location, and arrowheads indicate the corresponding direction.
sents.zh: 箭尾标记了力的作用点或初始速度的标注位置，箭头则指向相应的方向。

sents.en: Scene and method orders were randomized, with method identities hidden.
sents.zh: 场景和模型方法的顺序均经过随机排列，且模型方法的具体身份被隐藏。

paragraphs.en: Participants were asked to carefully observe the results and select one or more equally best videos independently for two criteria: (1) Physics plausibility : motion that best matches the text prompt and solid-force or gas-initial-velocity direction, considering both motions and their interaction when both phases are present. The arrows and text prompts were assumed to match. (2) Overall Video quality : the best visual and temporal quality.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者被要求仔细观察结果，并独立选择一个或多个同样优秀的视频，依据两个标准：(1) 物理合理性：运动效果需最符合文本提示以及固体受力或气体初始速度的方向，同时需要考虑两种状态都存在时它们之间的相互作用。 箭头和文本提示被假定是匹配的。 (2) 视频整体质量：最佳的视觉和时序质量。

sents.en: Participants were asked to carefully observe the results and select one or more equally best videos independently for two criteria: (1) Physics plausibility : motion that best matches the text prompt and solid-force or gas-initial-velocity direction, considering both motions and their interaction when both phases are present.
sents.zh: 参与者被要求仔细观察结果，并独立选择一个或多个同样优秀的视频，依据两个标准：(1) 物理合理性：运动效果需最符合文本提示以及固体受力或气体初始速度的方向，同时需要考虑两种状态都存在时它们之间的相互作用。

sents.en: The arrows and text prompts were assumed to match.
sents.zh: 箭头和文本提示被假定是匹配的。

sents.en: (2) Overall Video quality : the best visual and temporal quality.
sents.zh: (2) 视频整体质量：最佳的视觉和时序质量。

paragraphs.en: We received 15 complete questionnaires, yielding 15 × 32 = 480 15\times 32=480 scene evaluations per criterion. For each question, we computed each method’s preference rate as its number of selections divided by 480, expressed as a percentage. Each selected method was counted once per scene, including tied choices. Figure 4 reports these percentages.
paragraphs.zh: 我们收到了 15 份完整的问卷，由此获得了每个标准下 15 × 32 = 480 次场景评估。 对于每个问题，我们将每种方法的选择次数除以 480，并以百分比形式表示其偏好率。 每个被选中的方法在每个场景中计为一次，包括并列选择的情况。 图 4 报告了这些百分比。

sents.en: Figure 4 reports these percentages.
